text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] realtime latency detector — region=eu-west-1 — p99=2400ms (SLO=1200ms). Paging oncall: @oncall-eu :rotating_light:
jen: saw the bot alert, p99 spike on streaming endpoints. dashboards -> https://dash.redwood/internal/streams?region=eu-west-1
oncall-eu: I'm on it, joining the bridge now. any initial customer impact?
samuel: quick numbers from live-dashboard: /v1/stream p95 ~600ms, p99 ~2400ms, error rate okay. spike started ~4305556775.
maria: infra metrics show KV cache evictions up ~3x starting at same time. prefix_hit_ratio dropped.
devon: any deploys or config flips in last 30m?
jen: no deploys. autoscaler tried to add capacity but pods stuck Pending due to GPU quota.
oncall-eu: can we fail traffic to another eu zone/region temporarily? fallback policy exists but is off for this tenant.
samuel: eu-central p99 ~1100ms, eu-west-2 p99 ~1000ms. Fallback would likely improve tail.
devon: I can flip region_fallback on for prod routingpolicy; will do a controlled change and monitor.
devon: (action) toggled routing.policy.region_fallback = true via console at 4305556805 — verifying propagation.
ops-bot: action: routing change applied by devon at 4305556805
maria: KV metrics: prefix_hits still low but after routing change traffic shifted ~30% off eu-west-1.
jen: customer impact: initial alerts from CUST-1234 indicating short rebuffering on live sessions, ~0.3% of requests > SLO. Marking severity as 'degraded' for now.
oncall-eu: attempt to scale up streaming pool in eu-west-1, but cluster reports Insufficient GPU. Opening support ticket for quota increase.
samuel: quick diag command I ran: `kubectl get pods -n streaming -l region=eu-west-1 -o wide` -> several pods in Pending due to insufficient gpu resource.
samuel: as short-term mitigation I'm reducing batch_max_tokens from 512 -> 256 for streaming to lower tail latency.
devon: applied batching override via feature flag at 4305556822.
ops-bot: action: batching config updated by devon at 4305556822
jen: monitoring: p99 across EU dropped to ~1.15s after routing + batching changes. that's just under SLO (1.2s).
maria: customer reports of rebuffering reduced. marking customer impact as 'partial degradation' (no customer-facing outage).
oncall-eu: we'll keep watch for 30m. handoff plan: if stable, handoff to night oncall at 4305558400.
samuel: follow-ups: (1) request GPU quota increase for eu-west-1, (2) tune KV cache (increase mem for streaming nodes), (3) consider autoscaler fallback to cross-region earlier.
jen: adding incident stub to docs: docs/incident/CUST-1234-eu-latency (will expand postmortem).
oncall-eu: thanks all. removing active paging for now — stay alert on alerts. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: incident 4305556789 status=mitigated (mitigated_by=oncall-eu) at 4305556838
